Target Sectors

Which Kinds of Business It Is For

Our marketing and promotional services are strategically designed for diverse commercial entities operating in Jharkhand and West Bengal:

Retailers & Showrooms

Jewellery stores, garment showrooms, electronics dealers, automobile dealerships, and multi-brand outlets seeking local customer footfall.

Manufacturing & Industrial Firms

B2B manufacturers, steel & fabrication companies, packaging units, and industrial suppliers looking for commercial orders.

Colleges, Schools & Institutes

Educational institutions running admission campaigns, coaching centres, competitive exam academies, and skill development institutes.

Real Estate & Builders

Property developers and builders launching residential apartments, commercial shopping complexes, or plot development projects.

Healthcare, Hospitals & Clinics

Multi-speciality hospitals, diagnostic centres, dental clinics, and wellness centres building community trust and patient awareness.

Local Startups & Services

Emerging ventures, restaurants, event organizers, consultancies, and consumer service providers scaling their regional brand.

Service Inclusions

What Is Included in Our Marketing Services

From creative graphic design to on-ground execution and digital campaigns, we provide complete marketing solutions:

1. Posters, Print & Outdoor Display

High-visibility visual branding materials created and distributed for maximum public impact:

  • Posters & Banners: Eye-catching design and high-quality printing for storefronts and event hubs.
  • Flyers & Pamphlet Inserts: Targeted distribution in high-density residential and commercial colonies.
  • Standees & Point-of-Sale: Promotional stands for exhibitions, corporate offices, and retail stores.
  • Hoardings & Billboards: Strategic site selection and installation along prime arterial highways.

2. Social Media & Digital Marketing

Connecting your brand with targeted digital audiences across smartphones and computers:

  • Facebook & Instagram Advertising: Geo-targeted ad campaigns in Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Kolkata, Howrah.
  • Content & Reels Production: Engaging video snippets, product demonstrations, and testimonials.
  • Google Search & Maps: Getting your business found when local customers search for your services.
  • WhatsApp Marketing: Structured broadcasts and automated customer inquiry handling.

3. Local Promotion & Ground Activation

Real on-ground presence that drives direct interaction with your target community:

  • Canopy & Kiosk Setups: Direct interaction booths at busy markets, residential complexes, and fairs.
  • Roadshows & Van Promotions: Audio announcements, mobile display vans, and festive marketing drives.
  • Event Sponsorships: Local festival and sports event marketing for deep regional goodwill.
  • Business Networking: Direct B2B introductions to corporate and dealer networks in eastern India.

4. Business Branding & Corporate Identity

Building a credible and memorable brand image that commands trust in the marketplace:

  • Brand Strategy: Defining your unique selling proposition (USP) and competitive edge.
  • Logo & Brand Style Guide: Consistent typography, color harmony, and professional collateral.
  • Company Profiles & Catalogues: High-quality brochures, product catalogues, and pitch decks.
  • Signage & Storefront Design: ACP boards, LED acrylic letters, and branded office signage.
